description: HUD ORCF's weekly Section 232 underwriting queue report, summarized: how many 223(f), 223(a)(7) and new construction/241(a) applications are waiting, Express Lane counts, median and oldest days waiting, how long this week's underwriter assignments waited, the fiscal-year median wait, and optionally every saved weekly snapshot.

limit.description: Weeks of history to return (default 10, max 50).

offset.description: Weeks of history to skip, for paging.
